messages:
marcus: heads up — customer 'BrightCart' reported a big p99 regression on text-gen since ~03:10 UTC. saw p95 ~220ms -> 420ms and p99 spiking to ~1.4s. correlates with low overall traffic on those pods.
anya: ok curious — low qps + continuous batcher can hold too long waiting for min_batch. what pool/variant?
marcus: redwood-dedicated-prod:pool-a variant v2-quant. traffic pattern: many small single-shot requests (0.5-2 tokens average).
kevin: can you dump batcher metrics (hold_time_hist, batch_size_hist, inflightq) from one affected host?
lisa-support: forwarded customer's repro curl. minimal body so it is single-turn prompt. they said 03:10 after routine config rollout but not certain.
marcus: pasted logs from host-07: 
```
[03:11:02.123] batcher: incoming request id=abc123 size=1
[03:11:02.124] batcher: hold_window=50ms current_queue=2
[03:11:02.170] batcher: flush triggered by timeout wait=46ms batch_size=2
[03:11:02.170] runtime: start_infer token_count=7
[03:11:03.560] runtime: infer_done duration=1390ms
```
kevin: hmm infer duration seems normal; bulk of p99 coming from queue hold + runtime combined. but hold of ~46ms isn't huge — why p99 jumps to 1.4s? maybe KV cache miss or quant fallback for singletons.
anya: also note the sample shows runtime taking long. check model kernel selection logs — sometimes when batch_size <=2 we take ref path on some GPUs (slow kernels).
marcus: pulled model selection traces: for small batches fallback to fp16 path with slower schedule when <4 tokens; config param min_kernel_batch=4 in runtime is being ignored for that variant after rollout.
kevin: that matches our hypothesis — rollout changed coalescing heuristics. small-traffic -> batcher waits slightly longer to reach min_batch but then runtime picks slower kernel because batch size still small. leads to p99 tail.
anya: repro plan: 1) run local replay of customer's single-request stream against canary instance with both old and new coalescing. 2) capture batch_size distribution + kernel path chosen. 3) test early-flush (if wait>25ms && batch_size==1 -> force flush).
marcus: running replay now with traffic trace from brightcart (curl x100 at 20ms intervals).
marcus: results: old-coalesce p99=320ms; new-coalesce p99=1.38s. batch sizes in new: ~60% singletons, older config had aggressive early-flush so more singletons but runtime used optimized kernel for singletons (weird).
kevin: sounds like two independent changes collided: 1) coalescer wait increased to try and reduce tiny batches (improve cost). 2) runtime kernel mapping changed such that small batches map to slow kernels. when requests are sporadic you get both hold + slow kernel.
anya: mitigation options (short list):
- rollback coalescer wait to previous value (fastest mitigation)
- change runtime mapping so batch_size==1/2 use fast kernel for this model (risk perf regressions elsewhere)
- implement dynamic early-flush: flush if queue_age > X OR head_request_age > Y && batch_size < Z
- add telemetry: tag requests that hit slow kernel + correlate with source customer
marcus: support asks recommended rollback until we ship a proper fix — customer SLA impacted.
lisa-support: customer says this is high-priority, willing to accept short rollback.
kevin: agree. I'll prepare a targeted rollback patch for the coalescer wait param in config store and push canary.
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy for config:coalescer.wait -> 25ms -> targets=pool-a host-07, host-08
sre-oncall-bot: alert: customer BrightCart p99 decreasing on canary hosts (03:22).
marcus: canary looks good — p99 down to 340ms on canary, no errors. rolling to 25% of pool.
kevin: follow-up items (tracked in ticket INF-6421):
- add runtime guard to prefer fast kernels for tiny batches for this model (PR opened, code-owner @kevin)
- add coalescer config flag 'early_flush_threshold_ms' and tune via traffic-aware heuristic (PR @anya)
- update docs for coalescer tradeoffs (writeup of hold vs kernel mapping) (owner: @marcus)
- add alert runbook entry: if p99 > 1s AND small-batch-fraction > 40% -> consider rollback to previous coalescer wait
anya: also schedule a small-load canary test that replays single-request patterns weekly.
marcus: thanks team. summarizing: immediate rollback to canary value 25ms rolled out; monitoring will validate. we'll follow up with runtime kernel change to avoid slow path for tiny batches.
lisa-support: I've told BrightCart ops — will confirm once they see improvement. :thumbsup:
kevin: assigning myself to INF-6421. will link logs and replay scripts.
marcus: closing thread for incident — will update ticket when runtime PR merges. :white_check_mark:
